notes.text: The sheet carries authorial 32, heading 14 with two separated punctuation points, formula numbers (42) and (43), and pale other-hand foliation 72. The page has 25 main baselines; interlinear insertions and the four oblique margin baselines are separately inventoried.

The author labels the discussion a heuristic description of the Sigma_i and Sigma_ij and writes that it can be made considerably more precise in a context of topologie modérée. He describes choices of tubular neighbourhoods, writes formula (42) and the definition of the ringed T notation, and adds a marginal proposal expressing T_<i as a union of T_k. This is a report of the manuscript, with no proof check.

The author’s main NB reads Il aurait suffit ici, followed by a statement about choosing the neighbourhood in X_i lui =. The literal equals glyph abbreviates même in that phrase. The repeated spelling standart is preserved at every local occurrence. Neither this sentence nor the accompanying formula has been verified mathematically.

The first union is literally written with right-hand X_i although its bound is k<i and both witnesses give X_k. The left dotted glyph has Sigma-like bars and X-like diagonals with uncertain layer order. The second ambient expression retains the overdrawn X_j and a visible small oval after the dotted i in the T subscript. These are ink decisions; no intended identity or corrected notation is inferred.

For Sigma_ij the author describes a tubular neighbourhood T prime_ij, its dotted version, and a trace of a union with two written index components j and k on X. The first relation of that union bound remains ≤|<. He then calls S dot T prime_ij a partie singulière of an undotted T prime_ij; the parenthesis has no visible closing member before the following full stop. These manuscript formulations are retained without verification or repair.

The lower paragraph has an inserted T(S dot T prime_ij), an inserted union T_k above réunion, and an inserted de whose curved leader attaches after et. A single live de beneath the first insertion leader is preserved. The author replaces a partly masked prendra by raised aura and gives formula (43). The lower-left drawing consists of an oval, one filled point, and three slightly rising strokes; a small white gap separates the point from the middle stroke.

No mathematical argument, theorem, implication or conditional theorem was supplied or checked in this reading. All mathematical statements in these notes are attributed to the manuscript. check_events is empty because visual transcription and comparison alone are not proof checking.

In the lower de S dot T prime_ij phrase, tiny detached dark traces appear below-left of the T stem. Their provenance as pen-start/reworking or surface traces is uncertain, and no coherent extra glyph or attachment is recoverable. They are recorded locally in the comment and audit reading without inventing a linguistic token. In the first dotted X/Sigma and the second X_j, all visible overworking is described without inventing an underlying deleted letter.

The final Sigma_ij j descender meets the paper edge; no further stroke below the edge and no terminal punctuation for(43) can be recovered. The reader inspected the whole image, both original halves, and each saved first-pass crop. No OCR, external research, TeX compilation or second-pass recropping was used.

main_review:
Root inspected native whole073 once and read both complete witnesses and M0637–44. Author32 at head; heading14 Description heuristique des Sigma_i,Sigma_ij with underline stopping before the formula symbols; other-hand foliation72 below. Written standart recurs, including the raised quoted insertion with T_<i and its curved leader after tubulaire. A cancelled fermé candidate and heavily overwritten dotted X_i/Sigma_i need crops. Formula42 and the separate circle/dot definition have local degree/index placement; left margin NB contains On peut prendre and a union formula, needing rotation. Parenthetical main NB visibly contains Il aurait suffit ici; do not repair the tense or supply en fait from H. lui followed by a short overlined m/equality-like group needs crop. The second construction contains crowded X_j subtraction/intersection and ring T_<i/extra0, equality X'_i; preserve local indices. Later deleted prendre, both ds/dans short forms, the mark after dotT'_ij, union bounds and X-index, donc c'est, singular-part description and parenthesis require first crops. Figure has one closed oval-like outline, one filled point and three rightward near-horizontal strokes: central stroke begins at the point, others at the right boundary; compare all ends and joins on crop. Later T(S dotT'_ij), unionT_k and de are raised insertions; on aura replaces crossed prendra. The X---X_j sequence is unresolved on whole. Final43 formula lies close to bottom edge. No mathematical proof check was performed; precise local decisions await crops.

Root subsequently explicitly viewed all 28 first crops, p00–p27. A prior truncated attempt to emit p10–14 was not credited; these were successfully re-emitted and inspected. P00 gives author32, item14 and an underline ending before the Sigmas. Reinspection shows no separate comma after the first Sigma_i: its low hooked i stroke accounts for the apparent comma. Two separate dark points after 14 require explicit punctuation review. P01 retains dans|ds. P02 has quoted standart and T_<i above the line; fermé remains uncertain in strike state because a leader curves through the region. P03 has superposed X-like diagonals and Sigma-like bars, with layer order unestablished; the summand is X_i, with a dot and hooked short stem, no k arms, despite X_k in both witnesses. P04 formula42 ends in ring T_<i, with no separate final point. P05 has ring T_<i, an accented déf over equality, T_<i setminus dot T_<i and a terminal point. P06 reads Il aurait suffit ici, including its open parenthesis and underlined NB. P07 repeats standart. P08 reads lui followed by two equality bars, not m, and its final Sigma formula ends with a closing parenthesis, no point. P09 rotated margin reads On peut prendre, union k<i T_k, and où T_k est un vois. tub. standart des X_k; the crop's edge crowds the tub punctuation. P10 whole ambient formula has a second overdrawn X_j and a small closed oval after the dotted i, a little above its lower hook; preserve <i0|<i and document the unresolved degree.
